scientific_integrity: Proof relies on finite exact simplicial mapping-cone and natural integral chain identities; finite computer checks corroborate but do not establish all-dimensional claims.
scientific_limitations: The equivariant claim is on integral homology modules, not equivariant homotopy; exact two-degree homotopy is for generalized windmills only. An equivalent unindexed result may exist. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Mixed-dimensional clique-free windmills and their integral automorphism modules
